vetSays.line: You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lily just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Lily speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
